headline: I'm living paycheck to paycheck and can't get started. Is my energy blocking my money?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the cards, and your hand still found the one ready to begin.
A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand are laid out across his table.
You said you live paycheck to paycheck and cannot get started. What catches me is that the whole table is ready.
The financial beginning has not happened, and you are asking whether your energy is why.
Something turns up just where readiness should become a financial start. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs were alike, but you reached for the card where life continues inside the pause.
Green leaves grow from the wood above the still figure.
You asked whether your energy blocks the money. This card brings me to the living growth around the pause.
Still, the money is blocked while life continues around it.
Something sits between the living movement and the money. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding the money…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing revealed the picture, yet you chose the one who had already set out.
The bundle on his stick is small enough to hold in one hand.
You asked whether your energy is stopping the beginning. The small bundle keeps drawing my eye.
But you cannot get started financially, though the card is already on its way.
Whatever has hold of the beginning holds it without stopping you altogether. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of this…
